text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text: Wo-yeaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Energizing the shopping street with songs from the soul!
Hey, what do you think of this plan?!

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
What do I think...? It's way too loud.
Sorry, but a live performance in the shopping district is a bit...

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
What's your problem! If this venue can't appreciate
my music, I wouldn't perform here anyway!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Safe!
Sorry for yanking your arm so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's a relief. It seems she loses sight
of her surroundings once she gets fired up.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
...My bad. It's just that I can't find
a venue for my gig...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
She's going to spread her wings and take off from the streets!
Her very first live stage show!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Her singing ability has my personal seal of approval!
When I heard her by the station, my heart was deeply moved...!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, Pearl-san's the only one
who actually understands my talent.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the world will take notice soon enough.
Now, let's resume our stage hunt!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...So, hey!
Do you know of any places where we could host a show?
choice_data_list: Shall we search for one together?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Vwooooo-! Oo-yaaahhhh~~~!
Thank youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Like that! How was it?
Did it send shivers through your heart?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Manager
text_block_list.text:
Uh, well... I'm sorry.
I don't think that really fits the vibe of our cafe...
choice_data_list: Then let's try somewhere livelier next—

text_block_list.name: Venue Manager
text_block_list.text:
Our clientele is hip and youthful, so...
Ah, do you play disco music by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. As if I'd play that junk!
choice_data_list: Th-Then let's find a place that matches your musical style!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
How about some rock music
to add some flair to a place of relaxation?

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It doesn't quite hit the heart.
If you're going to shout, wouldn't a live house be better?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text: Uggghhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
What gives! Every single one of them...!
None of them can appreciate high-level music!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Well, fair enough.
These days, if you go viral online, you're set anyway!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, did ya know? Santa Monica,
my favorite band, got famous through the internet too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Heh... So there's that kind of approach, too.

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Then it's time to shoot an MV!
I'm gonna hit up every studio I know!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Is she planning to just barge in and force her way again?
It would be great if she could properly convey
her feelings and passion, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Looking good, girl!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
She's turning adversity into a springboard to grow—
She's facing a chance to polish herself!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even the frustration when things don't go well
makes great spice for creativity♪
choice_data_list: Now that you mention it, maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Still, we need to support her properly
so that she can fight her battle.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even strong convictions and burning passion
will eventually snap if winds keep howling against them.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
An ally who can hold you up when you're about to fall...
Everyone needs someone like that, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
From the moment her shout stole my heart,
I decided... that I'd be that pillar of support.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Besides, after today, there are plenty
of things I've come to understand—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry!
It'll all work out just fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl placed her full trust in the girl with utmost confidence.
The sheer breadth of her generosity was truly astounding...!
